summary.text: Bryan Terry is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 48, where he has served since November 2014, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Terry is on the ballot with Matt Ferry.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Terry was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 48 in 2014 and took office on November 4, 2014.
In the 2023–2024 session he chaired the Health Committee and was also assigned to the Calendar and Rules, Insurance, Naming and Designating, and State Government committees.
Terry's 2016 campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, said he had experience in the auto salvage and medical industries and described himself as a patient, physician, and small business owner.
